title: IR-Runbook-Phishing-Response
summary: Standard operating procedure for containing malicious inbound emails, phishing campaigns, attachment weaponization, and credential harvesting landing pages.
content:
1. Email Ingestion & Fleet Containment

1.1 Tenant-Wide Mail Purge: Execute automated hard-delete search across all Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace inboxes matching the sender envelope, subject regex, or internet message ID.

1.2 Sender & IP Blocking: Block sender domain, source IPv4/IPv6 address, and SPF/DKIM failing infrastructure at the perimeter Secure Email Gateway (SEG).

2. User Impact Assessment

2.1 Audit Clicks and Form Submissions: Correlate URL rewrite logs (Proofpoint, SafeLinks) to determine which corporate users clicked the malicious link and submitted credentials or multi-factor authentication codes.

2.2 Attachment Detonation: Submit malicious attachments (.docm, .iso, .exe, .zip, .html) to the private sandbox to extract secondary payload indicators of compromise (IoCs).

3. Identity & Session Remediation

3.1 Revoke Active User Tokens: Immediately invalidate refresh tokens and active browser sessions (Azure AD / Okta / Ping) for all users who submitted credentials on the phishing site.

3.2 Enforce Password Reset & FIDO2 Re-verification: Force an immediate password change and verify whether rogue MFA devices or authenticator apps were registered by the attacker.

steps.title: Purge phishing email from all recipient inboxes
steps.description: Trigger an enterprise compliance search and hard-delete the phishing email across all recipient mailboxes to prevent further user interaction.

steps.title: Block sender address, domain, and sending MTA at mail gateway
steps.description: Add the sender domain and originating mail server IP address to perimeter blocklists to prevent follow-up delivery waves.

steps.title: Audit gateway link click telemetry and sandbox attachments
steps.description: Correlate email gateway URL click logs to identify users who opened the link or downloaded attachments, and extract C2 indicators from sandbox detonations.

steps.title: Revoke active identity sessions and rotate credentials for impacted users
steps.description: Invalidate active OAuth refresh tokens and Azure AD/Okta sessions for users who submitted credentials, and enforce password rotation with MFA verification.
